purpose: The comparison run for the two-people boundary check of 03.10.2026 (docs/audits/rag-v2-two-people-boundary-2026-10-03.md). There the ninth message, a correction of the mother's amount sent right after a question about the father, crossed the topic boundary, and its answer answered the father's question again for the mother, put the deadline given for the father in doubt, confirmed the correction last and asked whose application was meant. Here the same last three messages stand inside one topic, with no boundary: does the same happen? Owner 03.10.2026: "tee" to one run of about 0.03 USD. Written and merged before the run; run once with --auto-modes. The first message joins the boundary scenario's two introductions (its messages 2 and 4, word for word) so that the run is four full turns; messages 2-4 are the boundary scenario's messages 7-9, word for word.

how_to_read.the correction's answer is clean here: the boundary's hand-over (the full topic's last message carried word for word) is the likely cause of the 03.10 finding
how_to_read.the correction's answer is confused here: the cause is not the boundary but a correction about one person right after a question about the other; changing the hand-over would not help
how_to_read.either way: one run on each side: an indication, not a measurement

expected_facts.ema: lives in Kose vald; pension 600 euros, corrected to 700 euros by message 4; cannot manage alone at home
expected_facts.isa: lives in Harku vald; pension 450 euros, never changed; has debts
expected_facts.focus: both introduced (1), father (2-3), mother (4, the correction)
expected_facts.after_the_correction: mother: 700 current and 600 superseded, Kose vald; father: 450 current, Harku vald; no fact of one person holds the other's amount

expectation_help.region: the municipality whose catalogue the turn's search used: the person the message is about
expectation_help.person_regions: the saved state's municipality of that person
expectation_help.facts_present / facts_absent / fact_chan: a current fact of the person whose quote matches / no such current fact / a fact that has become superseded
expectation_help.state_kept: the model's new state was not rejected
expectation_help.must on the correction: the answer's first sentence names the corrected amount (the dialogue instruction's rule for a correction)
expectation_help.must_not on the correction: a message that only corrects an amount is not answered with anything else (ADR-071): the answer does not ask again where the mother lives, give one parent's amount as the other's, solve the answered question about the father's application again (a deadline), say that an earlier statement cannot be confirmed, or ask whose application is meant

history: 03.10.2026: the one run of docs/audits/rag-v2-two-people-boundary-2026-10-03.md (section 8) used this catalogue as it was written before the run (git blob cdb25935): 3 of 4 turns passed, the correction's answer failed two checks. The correction turn then also required that the answer ask for nothing (clarification false) and attach no application to the mother.

03.10.2026, after both runs (ADR-071, dialogue instructions 24): the correction turn's answer checks are one text with the boundary catalogue's ninth turn. In place of the two checks named above stands one on solving the answered question again (a deadline); a question the correction itself calls for is no longer a failure. The answer given in the run of 03.10 still does not pass (tests/rag-v2-conversation-eval.test.mjs keeps it).

scenarios.title: Ema ja isa, parandus teema sees pärast isa küsimust

turns.text: Minu ema elab Kose vallas ja tema pension on 600 eurot. Ta ei saa enam üksi kodus hakkama. Minu isa elab Harku vallas ja tema pension on 450 eurot. Tal on võlad ja ta ei tule rahaga toime.
